verdict.rationale: Linear provides deep hooks for agent-to-agent and tool-to-agent handoff: issues can be delegated (not just assigned) to agents which act with full workspace context, Linear Agent integrates with Claude Code/Codex and GitHub Copilot's cloud agent, an MCP server and GraphQL API/webhooks expose data programmatically, and features like session checkpoints, delegated-issue tracking, and 'Write with Agent' pulling Slack/change context show explicit efforts to preserve context across handoffs.
